items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I carried his card around for years

ctx.x: He wrote "Open The Door, Richard." Well, his Dad was an old-time banjo player who played a five-string banjo, that had a good connection with the studios. His name was... He called any group he got together Satchel McVea and His Howdy Band. I carried his card around for years, I thought it was such an unusual name.

When you made this particular movie, for instance... Because I know what that's about, and I've seen the thing. I've only seen the little bit with you guys in it. But you're only on there for a minute-and-a-half even if that...
